class.jaymoskingdoms.option.reaper.desc: Swear to no god. Something older answers, and it has no shrine and no favour to give: it is paid in blood and in deaths, and all of death magic opens to you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reaper.stage.1: A cold settles on your shoulders. It is not the weather.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reaper.stage.2: The cold has weight now. It leans on you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reaper.stage.3: Something behind you has learned to reach.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reaper.stage.5: You are warm for the first time in a long while. Nothing near you is.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reaper.hungers: It is hungry. It has started on you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reaper.fed: It has eaten. It lets go of you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reaper.no_dead: There is nobody here to raise.
message.jaymoskingdoms.warlock.death: This debt is a death. Kill something.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.grue.reape: Stand away from that one, child. There is something at their back I buried once.
Do you feel that cold? No? Good. Keep it that way and keep walking.
That one does not travel alone. Do not ask me what with.
Eyes up, recruit. That one carries the enemy's colours and does not know it.
I have seen what stands behind that one on the far side of a ford. Guard up.
Never turn your back on that one, recruit. It is not them I mean.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.grue.reape: Oh, little one. Be kind to that one, and do not stand close.
There is a hand on that poor soul's shoulder. I cannot lift it. I have tried, before.
Come away, little one. Some company cannot be kept safely.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.grue.reap: Dear, that one is being read over the shoulder, and not by anything that can read.
Mark that one, dear, and stay out of their shadow. It is not all theirs.
I will not say what follows that one. I told you: it has a name I will not say aloud.
